 """Evaluation of small arithmetic formulas."""
 
+import operator
 from collections.abc import Mapping
+from math import isfinite, pow
 
 
 class EvalError(ValueError):
     """The formula is malformed or cannot be evaluated."""
 
 
+_NUM_CHARS = frozenset("0123456789")
+_NAME_CHARS = frozenset("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_")
+
+_TOKEN_NAMES = {
+    "NUMBER": "NUMBER",
+    "NAME": "NAME",
+    "LPAREN": "(",
+    "RPAREN": ")",
+    "COMMA": ",",
+    "PLUS": "+",
+    "MINUS": "-",
+    "STAR": "*",
+    "SLASH": "/",
+    "PERCENT": "%",
+    "CARET": "^",
+    "EOF": "EOF",
+}
+
+
+class _Token:
+    __slots__ = ("kind", "value")
+
+    def __init__(self, kind, value=None):
+        self.kind = kind
+        self.value = value
+
+    def __repr__(self):
+        if self.value is not None:
+            return f"{self.kind}({self.value!r})"
+        return self.kind
+
+
+class _Tokenizer:
+    def __init__(self, text):
+        self._text = text
+        self._pos = 0
+        self._tokens = []
+        self._tokenize()
+
+    def _error(self, msg):
+        raise EvalError(msg)
+
+    def _tokenize(self):
+        text = self._text
+        i = 0
+        n = len(text)
+
+        while i < n:
+            ch = text[i]
+
+            if ch in " \t\n\r":
+                i += 1
+                continue
+
+            if ch in _NUM_CHARS:
+                start = i
